name: HEAD TRAMPOLINE
blurb: Air heavy bounces them 80 px and refunds a jump. Kill on the bounce is always blunt.
how: Hit a thug with a HEAVY while you are in the air: he bounces up (about a body length) and you get your jump back, so you can keep juggling.

name: FAMILY DISCOUNT
blurb: Your hits refill the partner's Steam. Shared combo lives if only one of you eats dirt.
how: Co-op: every hit you land refills your partner's STEAM. If one of you goes down, the combo counter is not lost.

name: OFFICE RAGE
blurb: Lights apply Staple bleed. Staple-kills explode paper. Lights still flash red until then.
how: Your LIGHT punches make thugs BLEED (damage over time). A thug who dies while bleeding bursts in paper and hurts those next to him.

name: QUIET LUNCH
blurb: SNAP on a back restores 8 HP. Missed SNAP is your problem.
how: Landing a SNAP finisher on a thug from behind heals you 8 HP.

name: DOUBLE SLAP
blurb: A Parenting Slap heals both 20% and they hit meaner for 2 seconds. Will be abused.
how: Reviving your partner (the Parenting Slap) heals you both 20% of max health, and you both hit harder for 2 seconds.

name: RICOCHET POLICY
blurb: Batwings bounce +1 off metal. Neon that is hit is a conversation.
how: Your Batwing throws bounce one extra time off metal things (cars, signs, bins) and can hit a second thug.

name: TUTORING
blurb: Every 8th light without eating dirt: the next shot fires twice. Homework.
how: Land 8 LIGHT punches in a row without getting knocked down: your next gun shot fires twice.

name: PENDULUM POLITICS
blurb: A web-slam kill leaves a lamp. The Son can grab it. Solo: you still get the lamp.
how: Killing a thug with a web-slam leaves a lamp behind. Walk into it to pick it up (works solo too).

name: COP OUT
blurb: SNAP on a cop refunds one Wanted stamp. The paperwork files itself.
how: A SNAP finisher on a cop removes one WANTED star, so fewer cops come after you.

name: STEAM TAX
blurb: Lights cost 0 Steam. Heavies refund 8. The clinic calls it a loophole.
how: LIGHT punches use no STEAM at all, and every HEAVY gives you 8 STEAM back.

name: FAMILY BLITZ
blurb: Dash i-frames +4. Slide hits twice. SoR4 called; it wants its meter back.
how: DASH makes you untouchable a little longer, and a SLIDE (DASH + down) hits twice.

name: STREET CREDIT
blurb: Combo cash-out pays double Scrap. Let the timer die on purpose. That's the bit.
how: When your combo timer runs out, the combo pays out double SCRAP (gold). Let the timer end instead of getting hit.

name: COPING MAGNET
blurb: Pickup vacuum radius +110. Halls of Torment called it a trait. We call it enabling.
how: You pull in gold, XP and pickups from much further away (+110 px).

name: ORBIT FORM
blurb: Two blades orbit you and chip. Not a meadow. Still illegal in group.
how: Two blades circle around you and cut any thug that touches them. Always on.

name: DRIP FEED
blurb: Aura ticks light on anything in hugging distance. The clinic calls it presence.
how: Thugs standing right next to you take a little damage every second.

name: VACUUM HOUR
blurb: One huge magnet pulse. Every chip remembers your name. Then it forgets again.
how: Once, right now: every coin, gem and XP orb on the street flies to you.

name: OPEN TAB
blurb: Kills pay +4 pinball to whoever landed it. The clinic calls it a tab. We call it a personality.
how: Every kill gives +4 bonus score (XP) to the hero who landed it.

name: INVOICE VOID
blurb: Legendary. Heavies strip an extra plate on armored bosses. The Director hates this card.
how: Against armored bosses your HEAVY breaks one extra armor plate, so their health bar opens up faster.

name: NAMED LINE
blurb: Perfect tricks pay +12 and keep the speed. The coach would bill this. Unique card art.
how: Parkour: every PERFECT trick pays +12 score and you keep your speed instead of slowing down.

name: STOMP POLICY
blurb: Face stomps score double. Brain on three is still the personality.
how: Stomping a downed thug (down + HEAVY near a body) scores double.

name: IDLE ALIBI
blurb: Legendary. Patrol banks +50% gold. Closed still counts. The alley works for you.
how: The PATROL (idle gold in the hideout) earns 50% more gold while you are away.

name: COURIER POLICY
blurb: On the lemon van, rail shots refund 1 ammo. The clinic still bills the crash.
how: On the van chase, every rail shot that hits gives you 1 bullet back.

name: ORCHARD COPAY
blurb: Slide hills and rope swings pay +8. Hay is not a couch. The lake still wants a copay.
how: In Copay Orchard, every hill slide and rope swing pays +8 score.

name: BRINE LUNGS
blurb: Legendary. In Ledger Dive, magnet radius +80 and eels chip slower. The spa hates this.
how: In Ledger Dive: pickups are pulled from +80 px further and eels hurt you less often.

name: WALL BOUNCE
blurb: Throws bounce off smashables AND the invoice wall. SoR4 called it a juggle. We bill it.
how: Thugs you THROW (LT / U next to them) bounce off breakable props and walls and can be hit again in the air.

name: SNACK BREAK
blurb: Smash a fridge or kiosk and the combo does not die. Extra scrap. The till still wants a copay.
how: Breaking a fridge, kiosk or other big prop does not end your combo, and gives extra SCRAP.

name: REVENGE POLICY
blurb: After you eat dirt, the next hit is a Revenge. Longer window. SoR4 special restore, billed.
how: After you get knocked down, your next hit is a REVENGE hit (big damage). You get longer to land it.

name: CART HOP
blurb: Shopping carts last longer. Jump off for a pop. Don't tell tutoring.
how: Shopping carts roll 0.6 s longer. Press JUMP while riding to leap off high.

name: WEAPON CATCH
blurb: Thrown pipes bounce back once. SoR4 called it a juggle. We call it recycling.
how: A melee weapon you throw (LT / U while holding it) comes back to you once, like a boomerang.

name: CLASH POLICY
blurb: Heavy vs a telegraphing punk chips extra and refunds Steam. Huntdown called it a katana. We bill the spark.
how: Hit a thug with a HEAVY while he is winding up his attack (red flash): extra damage (+6) and STEAM back.

name: AWNING HOP
blurb: Awnings bounce higher. Sunset Overdrive storefronts, billed as copays.
how: Shop awnings bounce you much higher (+100).

name: NEWS CYCLE
blurb: Pop a newsstand and a pipe drops with the Paper Boy. The headline still wants a copay.
how: Breaking a newsstand drops a pipe you can pick up (LT / U).

name: OIL POLICY
blurb: Oil drums blast wider. SoR4 threw bodies at barrels. We bill the crater.
how: Oil drums explode in a wider circle (+36 px), hitting more thugs.

name: POLE VAULT
blurb: Streetlight swings launch higher. Sunset Overdrive rented the lamp. Tutoring can wait.
how: Swinging on a street light launches you much higher (+100).

name: DIVE BOUNCE
blurb: A dive that lands hops you back up. Sunset Overdrive slam bounce, billed as falling with intent.
how: A dive attack (in the air: down + HEAVY) that lands bounces you back up into the air.

name: HOOD HOP
blurb: Car hoods bounce higher. Sunset Overdrive rented the bumper. We stole the copay.
how: Car hoods bounce you much higher (+100).

name: STEAM LID
blurb: Pop a manhole and nearby punks eat the steam. SoR4 hid knives under crates.
how: Opening a manhole blasts steam that hurts thugs standing near it.

name: SLIDE TAX
blurb: Slides last longer and cut a second invoice. Vector went under. We billed the asphalt.
how: SLIDE (DASH + down) lasts longer and hits a second time.

name: ESCAPE CLAUSE
blurb: Secret. Tower falls refund a jump. The lease did not sign this.
how: Falling off a tower gives you a jump back mid-air, so you can save yourself.

name: TALKING STICK
blurb: Secret. SNAP heals 4 extra. Nobody passed it. You took it.
how: Every SNAP finisher heals you 4 HP more.

name: LANDLORD VOID
blurb: Secret. Legendary. Heavies on armored punks strip two plates. The mortgage cried.
how: Against armored thugs your HEAVY breaks two armor plates instead of one.

name: SHUTTLE RIP
blurb: Secret. Mid-air slap windows last longer. The wellness drone still wants a copay.
how: In the air, the window to land a slap (LIGHT) is longer (+0.08 s), so air combos are easier.

name: PROTEIN SHAKE
blurb: +12% damage.
how: All your damage goes up by 12% per level (12% / 24% / 36%).

name: RUNNING SHOES
blurb: +8% move speed.
how: You walk and run 8% faster per level. At level 3 DASH also costs less STEAM.

name: THICK HOODIE
blurb: +10 max health, healed now.
how: +10 max health per level, and you heal that amount right away.

name: CHI BATTERY
blurb: +35% CHI from hits and kills.
how: You fill CHI (the meter for element arts, LIGHT + HEAVY together) 35% faster per level.

name: PAPERBOY DRONE
lv: A drone over your shoulder throws a rolled paper at a thug every 2.2 s.
blurb: A drone over your shoulder throws a rolled paper at a thug every 2.2 s.
how: A small drone flies with you and throws paper at the nearest thug by itself. Higher levels: faster and more papers.

name: STAPLER ORBIT
lv: A stapler circles you, biting anyone it passes (bleed).
blurb: A stapler circles you, biting anyone it passes (bleed).
how: A stapler circles around you and bites thugs it passes, making them BLEED. Higher levels: more staplers.

name: MOLOTOV DAD
lv: Every 6 s a bottle flies at the nearest thug and the street burns.
blurb: Every 6 s a bottle flies at the nearest thug and the street burns.
how: Every few seconds a bottle is thrown at the nearest thug by itself and the ground burns. Higher levels: more often.

name: STRAY CAT
lv: A street cat follows you and pounces on thugs (claws bleed).
blurb: A street cat follows you and pounces on thugs (claws bleed).
how: A cat follows you and jumps on thugs; its claws make them BLEED. Level 3: two cats.

name: REPO DRONE
lv: A drone hovers by you and zaps a thug every 2.5 s (stun).
Every 1.5 s, the zap jumps to a second thug.
blurb: A drone hovers by you and zaps a thug every 2.5 s (stun).
how: A drone zaps a nearby thug every few seconds and stuns him (he can't attack). Higher levels: faster, longer stun.

name: PIGEON SQUAD
lv: Every 6 s a flock sweeps down the lane, hitting and stunning everyone.
Every 4 s, more pigeons, more damage.
blurb: Every 6 s a flock sweeps down the lane, hitting and stunning everyone.
how: Every few seconds pigeons fly down the street, hitting and stunning every thug in the way.

name: AIR HORN
lv: SHOOT with empty hands: everyone close is stunned 1.2 s. Cooldown 14 s.
Stun 2 s, cooldown 10 s, knocks them down.
blurb: SHOOT with empty hands: everyone close is stunned 1.2 s. Cooldown 14 s.
how: Press SHOOT (RB / O) with no gun in hand: every thug near you is stunned. Then it needs to recharge.

name: SMOKE BOMB
lv: SHOOT with empty hands: smoke, 2.5 s untouchable, thugs lose you. Cooldown 18 s.
Cooldown 12 s, you heal a little in the smoke.
blurb: SHOOT with empty hands: smoke, 2.5 s untouchable, thugs lose you. Cooldown 18 s.
how: Press SHOOT (RB / O) with no gun in hand: smoke, nothing can hurt you for 2.5 s and thugs lose track of you.

name: KNIFE BELT
blurb: +3 throwing knives now, carry 3 more.
how: +3 throwing knives now and you can carry 3 more. Throw one with LT / U when nothing is underfoot.

name: SLINGSHOT
lv: SHOOT with empty hands fires a pebble. No ammo, ever.
blurb: SHOOT with empty hands fires a pebble. No ammo, ever.
how: Press SHOOT (RB / O) with no gun in hand to fire a pebble. Never runs out.

name: BRASS KNUCKLES
blurb: +10% damage, heavies stagger longer.
how: +10% damage per level, and HEAVY hits stun thugs a little longer.

name: VAMPIRE TOOTH
lv: Every 2 kills. Brush twice a day.
blurb: Heal 1 HP every 4 kills.
how: You heal 1 HP every few kills (4, then 3, then 2 at max level).

name: TIE BOOMERANG
lv: Every 3 s Dad's tie flies out and back, cutting everyone on the way.
blurb: Every 3 s Dad's tie flies out and back, cutting everyone on the way.
how: Every few seconds Dad's tie flies out and comes back, cutting every thug on the way.

name: HEAT WAVE
lv: Every 6 s a ring of heat rolls out and sets thugs close by alight.
blurb: Every 6 s a ring of heat rolls out and sets thugs close by alight.
how: Every few seconds a ring of heat rolls out from you and sets nearby thugs on fire.

name: THROWING BAG
blurb: +3 MOLOTOVS now (SHOOT + up).
how: Gives you throwables: aim up and press SHOOT (RB / O) to throw them (molotovs, then flashbangs, then grenades).
